'**Legendary** / When this enters the arena, deal 1 arcane damage to any target.' Light Illusionist Instant - Figment (DuskTillDawn).

LEGENDARY NOT AUTHORED: it is in printed_keywords and fires from the card DB keywords field - re-authoring it would be a defect.

ETB TRIGGER: TRIGGERED + ON_ENTER_PLAY, mapped at trigger_types.py:30 and dispatched from Zone.add on real arena entry - same shape as the sibling drafts figment_of_judgment_yellow / figment_of_erudition_yellow / figment_of_triumph_yellow.

ANY TARGET: DEAL_ARCANE (effect_types.py:1188-1219, read this session) with target 'ANY' routes to _deal_arcane_to_objects (:988-1040, read this session): the pool is BOTH heroes plus every ally on either side, and the controller is asked to pick one (max_targets defaults to 1, so no explicit max_targets needed - matches 'any target', singular). Spelling copied from the corpus majority (enion_surge_*, aether_hail_blue, burn_bare).

RESIDUAL CAVEAT: the shared chooser offers slugs as labels and is offered even when the only legal targets are obvious; behaviourally correct, cosmetically rough. Engine-level, not expressible in JSON.
